result.summary: Found 1 major issue: a restaurant card displays an invalid delivery price ('€NaN'), indicating a data formatting or calculation error.

issues.description: The delivery fee for 'Smash Bros Burgers' is rendered as '€NaN delivery', which is invalid user-facing content.
issues.suggestion: Fix the underlying data source or formatting logic so that a valid numeric price (or 'Free delivery'/'€0 delivery' if applicable) is displayed instead of NaN.
